title: Do LLMs Really Forget? Hidden-State Leakage in Model Unlearning and How to Fix it
abstract: arXiv:2609.36612v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unlearning in large language models (LLMs) is typically evaluated at the output level, where a model appears to suppress sensitive or undesirable content. In this work, we show that such evaluations can create an illusion of forgetting: even when output-level leakage is eliminated, sensitive information can remain encoded in the model's hidden representations. We first provide a theoretical analysis establishing a fundamental separation between output suppression and representational erasure. Specifically, we show that the decoder can be made arbitrarily insensitive to sensitive directions, driving output-level leakage to zero, while the hidden representations retain the underlying information. To empirically validate this phenomenon, we train generative probe decoders on hidden states across transformer layers, enabling layer-wise measurement of information leakage. translated_title: 大语言模型真的遗忘了吗？模型遗忘中的隐状态泄漏及其修复方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）中的“遗忘”通常是在输出层面进行评估的，即模型表面上抑制了敏感或不需要的内容。在这项工作中，我们表明这种评估方式可能造成一种遗忘的假象：即使输出层面的泄漏已被消除，敏感信息仍可能保留在模型的隐藏表示中。我们首先提供了理论分析，建立了输出抑制与表示擦除之间的根本性分离。具体而言，我们证明可以使解码器对敏感方向任意不敏感，从而将输出层面的泄漏降至零，而隐藏表示中仍然保留着底层信息。为了实证验证这一现象，我们在Transformer各层的隐藏状态上训练生成式探针解码器，实现对信息泄漏的逐层测量。在三个广泛使用的基准（TOFU、MUSE和WMDP）以及多种……
tldr: 大语言模型的“遗忘”可能只是假象——即使输出层面不再泄漏敏感内容，敏感信息仍隐藏在模型的内部表示中，本文从理论与实证上揭示了这一隐藏状态泄漏现象，并提出相应的修复方法。
en_tdlr: LLM unlearning can be an illusion: even when output-level leakage is eliminated, sensitive information remains encoded in the model's hidden representations, and this paper reveals this hidden-state leakage theoretically and empirically while proposing how to fix it.
